instruction.title: Color
instruction.text: In the text, VIEW shows you the Russian gerunds.

instruction.title: Click
instruction.text: Click on each Russian gerund you find in the text and VIEW will show you whether you guessed right or wrong.

instruction.title: Fill in the blanks
instruction.text: Fill in the blanks with the correct Russian gerund. If you guessed wrong or you find it too difficult you can get help by clicking on ?.
